relevance_note: Single case report of a man with Danon disease and a LAMP2 variant: "this patient was hemizygous for a previously unreported deletion mutation (p.Gly221Ilefs∗19) in the LAMP2 gene".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; values and spans typed into a small Python builder script in the scratch directory, which only assembled the JSON and checked spans verbatim. Table 1 (blood tests) and Table 2 (amyloidosis tests) are headings only in the Markdown (no table content); lab values come from the text. In scope: the proband ('patient'), his mother (carrier per Fig. 5 legend and abstract), his father (tested negative per Fig. 5 legend) and his sister (died of cirrhosis at 12, not tested). Not extracted: the '2 boys' of the first description of Danon disease (Introduction, cited as ^[1], whose reference entry is Kuroda 2019, an apparent citation mismatch) and other literature cohorts in the Discussion, which give only group-level facts. 'There was no family history of cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, or sudden cardiac death' names no relative, so it excludes nothing for the mother, father or sister. Variant class left 'not reported' because the paper contradicts itself: the abstract calls p.Gly221Ilefs∗19 a 'novel missense mutation' and the case report a 'previously unreported deletion mutation'; no class derived from the HGVS string. No cDNA or transcript printed. Pathogenicity left 'not reported' (the paper says only novel/previously unreported and that it confirms the diagnosis). Mother's zygosity not stated. Other inconsistencies: the case report says he was 'previously in good health' and admitted for palpitations with WPW and paroxysmal wide QRS tachycardia, whereas the Discussion says he 'was admitted to the hospital with ventricular tachycardia' and 'initially presented with cognitive and mental disorders' (both recorded as observed as stated); a cardiac resynchronization therapy pacemaker is described but the Discussion refers to 'the site of the ICD'; imaging suggested amyloidosis and the fat biopsy was Congo red positive, but amyloid cardiomyopathy was stated as excluded (recorded excluded). Hedged statements not recorded as observed: 'suspected hypertrophic non-obstructive cardiomyopathy', 'myocardial amyloidosis'/'suspected amyloidosis', 'suggest muscle damage'. Age at onset not stated (only '3 years from symptom onset to death' and death at 22), so onset and last-evaluation ages are 'not reported'; age at death recorded. Head CT 'No abnormality was found' recorded as written (excluded 'abnormality on computed tomography of the head'), excluding nothing more specific. No stacked cells.
